changes.comment: `FeishuInboundEvent` carries the message body once, as required `contentParts`. The `parsedText` flat copy and the `resources` duplicate of the resource parts are removed, and with them the render/attachment fallbacks that reconstructed a body from them when parts were absent — every production path already supplied parts. The serialized `<content>` block, attachment resolution and de-duplication, mentions, code, incomplete-content reporting, and merged-forward handling are unchanged.
